header.title: Hi, I'm Kamila
header.description: Graphic designer. I love creating original things.

about.title: About
about.description: At the end of 2023, I began my studies in Computer Graphics and Multimedia Production at [University of Information Technology and Management](https://wsiz.edu.pl/). I had already been passionate about painting, both traditional and digital. My skills began to develop at a rapid pace, and today I am an experienced graphic designer with a focus on marketing.

items.title: Marketing Materials
items.description: I create modern and aesthetic promotional assets – leaflets, posters, catalogs, banners, reels, and social media graphics – tailored to the brand’s character and current design trends.

items.title: Digital Illustrations
items.description: I produce custom illustrations, from simple vector icons to advanced digital paintings – ideal for publications, websites, and advertising materials.

items.title: Packaging Design
items.description: I design functional and visually appealing packaging that combines strong aesthetics with clear brand messaging and production requirements.

items.title: Visual Identity
items.description: I develop complete visual identities – logos, color palettes, typography, and graphic styles – creating a cohesive and professional brand image.

items.title: DTP & Print Preparation
items.description: I prepare files for professional printing according to industry standards, ensuring high-quality output, accurate colors, layouts, and compliance with printing guidelines.

items.title: Photo Editing & Retouching
items.description: I specialize in retouching, color correction, photo compositing, and photomanipulation, delivering polished and cohesive visual materials.

items.title: Product Visualizations
items.description: I create realistic 2D/3D product visualizations for packaging, items, and components – perfect for presentations, campaigns, and e-commerce.

items.title: UX/UI Design
items.description: I design clean and visually appealing interfaces and layouts for websites and applications, focusing on clarity, usability, and cohesive visual style.

items.title: Moodboards & Creative Concepts
items.description: I prepare moodboards, style directions, and creative concepts that help define the visual direction of a brand or campaign.

items.title: 2D Animations
items.description: I create animated logos, illustrated elements, and kinetic typography – ideal for social media, advertisements, intros/outros, and promotional content.

projects.title: Check out my latest work
projects.description: I've worked on a variety of projects, from simple mockups to complex layouts. Here are a few of my favorites.

fuoco-nero.title: Fuoco Nero - Premium Coffee Brand Website
fuoco-nero.description: Fuoco Nero is an exclusive premium coffee brand created for true connoisseurs. Its visual identity is built on a **dark, elegant aesthetic**, strong contrasts, and refined details that emphasize the luxurious character of the product - from packaging to the digital experience.

vasabi.title: Vasabi - Restaurant Menu
vasabi.description: Vasabi restaurant menu design combines **modern minimalism** with **traditional Japanese aesthetics**. The goal was to create a visual identity that feels both **elegant and authentic**, reflecting the fusion of Japanese and Asian cuisine.

core-motion-physiotherapy.title: Coremotion Physiotherapy - Brochure
core-motion-physiotherapy.description: The **Coremotion Physiotherapy** brochure was designed to communicate the clinic’s mission of _“Pain-Free Living”_ while providing essential information about their physiotherapy services in a clear and approachable way. The tri-fold format ensures a professional and practical layout, perfect for distribution in clinics, community centers, and wellness events.

kvisual.title: Branding / Visual identity design - Kvisual
kvisual.description: Kvisual is a **modern graphic design studio** specializing in visual identity design, advertising materials, and promotional campaigns. The brand combines **simplicity with expressiveness**, using clean lines, contrasting colors (black, white, and creative purple #6020B8), and a **geometric, futuristic-inspired logo**.
